Description

FATHOM is the next game from Pawsmonaut Games — the solo-indie studio behind sleeper survival-crafting hit AETHUS.

As-yet unannounced, FATHOM is a laid-back desktop companion idler game set beneath the waves of an alien ocean. FATHOM sits on the bottom of your screen while you work or play.

Deploy ROVs to observe, scan and catalogue the life of this strange world as you extend your reach further under the waves and expand your floating research base.

Use the research you generate to unlock new scientific tools and minigames as well as new constructions for your base.
Send expeditions to new regions to discover brand new species and discoveries.

Further details on FATHOM will be announced in due course!
If you're press and would like an early look, please feel free to reach out at hello@pawsmonaut.games.
